changes.comment: Internal: consume the renamed @rxc/controls-core + @rxc/controls surface. The published legacy API is deliberately unchanged -- ControlChange keeps its `All` member (127) and its numeric reverse mapping, now declared here rather than re-exported from the engine, and FormEditState keeps the legacy `readonly` spelling via a local wrapper since the engine moved to `readOnly`. convertSetup maps `elems` -> `elements` and `dontClearError` -> `keepErrors` explicitly instead of letting them ride an `as` cast, and the legacy `control.setInitialValue(v)` method now calls `wc.reset` (which is what it always meant) rather than the engine's renamed `setInitialValue`, which is the baseline move.
